hero.title: Know the way is clear before you go
hero.sub: With parents, kids, a wheelchair or friends from abroad: we check the way from parking to restrooms at Donghae sights and plan your day.
hero.cta: Plan my day in a minute
hero.say: Hi! I'm Dongi, your Donghae travel buddy. Who are you traveling with today?
mode.label: Rate places for
plan.greet: Hi! Tap a few big buttons and I'll plan a Donghae trip using only places that are open on your day.
q.move: How does everyone get around? I'll only pick paths that work. Nothing is saved.
q.style: What do you enjoy? Pick any.
q.last: Last one: how long, and where do you start?
plan.done: I planned {n} stops. Take a look!
result.allOk: Every stop is easy to get around
result.caution: {n} stop(s) need care. Check the notes under each place.
safety.say: These are open now. Please call before you go.
report.say: Something blocked at {p}? One photo is enough.
report.thanks: Thank you! The next traveler will have an easier time.
share.title: Share
share.say: The link opens the same route. Your choices live only in the link.
error.server: Can't reach the server. Please try again shortly.
x.signals: {c} of {n} traffic lights within 300m show a countdown
x.tour: Donghae City Tour ({days}) from {board}, {first}–{last}, every {m} min · {fare}. Stops near {n} places on this course.
x.tourWheel: Wheelchair boarding isn't listed in public data; please ask: {c}
x.stay: {n} licensed lodgings in the {z} area (Donghae City data). Room accessibility not yet checked.
x.mobilityWho: Eligibility is limited (e.g. people with severe mobility impairments) — check before you travel.
talk.ph: Or just tell me (e.g. travelling with my mom, her knees hurt)
card.none: That isn't in the public data yet.
card.unverified: {n} in total · accessibility not yet checked.
rep.title: Tell us about this path
rep.help: Upload a photo and AI looks for steps, curbs and slopes, then sends a suggestion to our reviewers. Grades change only after a person checks. Photo location data is removed.
rep.busy: AI is looking at the photo…
rep.review: A reviewer checks this before the course grade changes.
rep.noai: Report received. AI isn't connected, so the photo wasn't analysed.
plan.sub: Answer with the buttons, or just type below.
plan.wished: The {n} places you added will go into your route.
foot.team: 2026 Hallym G-Lab@Donghae AI Hackathon · Team Donghaemulgwa BaekduAI
foot.data: Data: Donghae City open data (data.go.kr), Korea Tourism Organization TourAPI, National Medical Center, KMA. Access rules: Korean accessibility law (Annex 1) plus team rules.
foot.ai: Dongi's chat, route reasons and photo checks run on the Anthropic Claude API. Access grades and timing come from a rule engine, not AI.
q.when: When are you going? Pick a date and start time — I'll leave out places closed that day.
q.meal: What kind of place is comfortable for meals? Pick any.
